author: BimboMarie
body:
if there's any mods that see this id just like to say that im not  hacker at all and nobody said anything about me hacking before, I've got two brothers on nebula with me who can clearly state I do not have kill aura in which I was just banned for, it was so random and just popped up on my screen, nobody blamed me for 'kill aura' at any point and no mod asked me either? I find it really upsetting to know a mod can ban someone without having proof of any hacking? ive made a mod application for tomorrow and go on Avicus everyday and now to be suddenly banned when it was clearly a mistake, because I have never hacked in my life, before this I only had 2 infractions and im so confused as to why just now someone has blamed me of kill aura, as you guys know its very easy to kill people on Venomous TDM as its a one hit kill so I understand how someone can suspect a user of kill aura easily.

I really hope someone can do something about this I've been playing Avicus for so long now im not willing to give up because ive been mistakenly blamed for hacking.
